reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is TP because the resolved sink value at L61-L62 is attacker-controlled data from user input, despite the presence of encodeForHTML. The XSS occurs because the encoded SQL string is still concatenated into an HTML response context. evidence.note: SQL query constructed with user-provided parameter 'bar' directly concatenated into the query string
